تعتنقين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَنِقِينَ (taʕtaniqīna) /taʕ.ta.ni.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# تُعْتَنَقِينَ (tuʕtanaqīna) /tuʕ.ta.na.qiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
